warehouse_notes.description: One row per note, with its body, author, date, and visibility.

columns.visibility: Access level of the note, e.g., open, closed, or pending

warehouse_order_picks.description: One row per pick event, recording which picker picked which order and when.

columns.order_ref: Reference code of the picked order (anonymized)
columns.picker: Code of the person who picked the order (anonymized)

warehouse_payments.description: One row per payment made to a payee.

columns.payee: Code of the party receiving payment (anonymized)

warehouse_requests.description: One row per request, linked to a supporting document.

columns.priority: Priority label of the request (values are inconsistent, e.g., pending, open)
columns.status: Request state, e.g., active or closed
columns.documents_id: id of the related row in warehouse_documents

warehouse_vendors.description: One row per vendor company, linked optionally to an incident record.

columns.rating: Integer vendor score; scale is not documented and values exceed typical 1-5 ranges
columns.incidents_id: id of the related row in warehouse_incidents
